text:
maya: Quick note 
Saw another onboarding bump: the quickstart curl in README breaks for a surprising number of Windows users. They paste from GitHub, run it in PowerShell, and get auth / parse errors.

maya: Example we ship: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

maya: Problems observed: single quotes prevent env var expansion in pwsh, GitHub copy button sometimes strips escapes, and CRLF can sneak into the JSON body. Users hit 401 or 400 and file tickets.

li: Yup. Also worth noting: some terminals alias curl to an internal command on Windows, so curl.exe is often the safe call.

trevor: Proposed quick fixes: (1) split quickstart into two visible panels: "mac/linux (curl)" and "Windows (PowerShell)"; (2) for PowerShell show Invoke-RestMethod with ConvertTo-Json or the one-line curl.exe variant; (3) link to a single-file sample script in the repo and recommend running that instead of copy/paste.

maya: +1. Additionally we should avoid showing plaintext tokens in examples and add a short security note reminding folks not to echo or paste secrets into shared consoles.

li: Longer-term: add a snippet sanitizer in docs build that normalizes line endings and strips invisible characters before publishing. That would reduce copy/paste corruption across platforms.

trevor: CI idea: add a docs/snippet-smoke job that runs on a matrix with windows-latest and ubuntu-latest. The job should: clone samples, run the platform-specific quickstart scripts (pwsh + bash), and verify a minimal successful response or correct error message.

ci-bot: Draft workflow change: docs/snippet-smoke -> strategy.matrix.os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]; includes a step to run an automated paste-sim (echo sanitized-json | Invoke-RestMethod) on pwsh. Proposal queued.

docs-bot: Filed DOCS-900: "Quickstart: Windows copy/paste resilience, add PowerShell panel, sanitize snippets in CI". Linked draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901 (draft).

maya: I'll open a tiny PR to add the Windows panel and swap the one-line curl example to a cross-platform-safe variant that references the sample file. trevor can add the CI job in a follow-up.

li: Awesome. Once merged, can we also update the Console onboarding email to point to the sample file instead of embedding the full curl? Many folks copy from that email directly.

maya: Good call 44d I'll update the onboarding snippet after the docs change.

trevor: Thanks all 44d small edits but should cut a lot of early support noise.
